title: fix(metadata): migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages keys a bundled type's slot-taken test by bundle member

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgCv2GYPwmTxLypN2D24qytv)_
epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbddaPx1Q15nCTHvS5

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：升级回填 `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` 判断"槽已被占"时，邮件模板这类按语言分成员的类型，现在把语言成员也算进槽位。
- 为什么改：同一个邮件模板，en-US 那行已绑包、fr-FR 那行没绑时，fr-FR 被误报 slot-taken，一直留在未绑状态。
- 风险与回滚：只影响这个回填脚本（运维手动跑），第一方 0 处；读取答案不变。同一语言的槽真被占时仍报 slot-taken，不覆盖。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/migrations/bind-database-loader-row-packages.ts` 的 `slotOf`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/migrations/bind-database-loader-row-packages.test.ts`，29 例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，专题座位落地。

Fixes #32489

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i -c -E "migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages|bind-database-loader-row-packages|slot-taken" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'` has no hit (exit 1)

## What changes

`migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` binds a `source = 'database'` row of a by-package type to the package its body names, and leaves a row `slot-taken` when that package already holds a row of the same slot. Its slot was `(type, name, package)`. A bundled type (`email_template`, discriminator `locale`, canonical `en-US`) holds a row per member in one `(package, name)` slot, as `DatabaseLoader.save` writes it since its member-aware save target (#32214, ADR-0150 child B part 1), and as the store's unique key `(type, name, package_id, COALESCE(bundle_member, ''))` reads it.

- `slotOf` now keys a bundled type by `(type, name, package, member)`. The member is `storedBundleMemberOf(type, body, row.bundle_member)`: the `bundle_member` column first, else the member the body declares, else canonical (`null`), the same spelling as the overlay column and the loader. Every other type keys as before.
- The module doc names the per-member slot.
- No change to `DatabaseLoader`, to any read, or to which rows are candidates.

| Situation | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unbound `fr-FR` `email_template` row (body names package A) beside A's bound `en-US` row of the same name | left `slot-taken`, `package_id` empty | bound to A | no: the backfill's own result; every read already answered A off the body (module doc), so no resolution answer moves |
| Unbound row of a member whose own slot in A is already bound (`fr-FR` beside bound `fr-FR`; canonical spelled `en-US` beside a canonical row that omits `locale`) | left `slot-taken` | left `slot-taken` (unchanged, pinned) | — |
| Two unbound rows of one member in one run | first bound, second left | unchanged (pinned) | — |
| Rows of a type that declares no member (`api`, `agent`, …) | slot `(type, name, package)` | unchanged, even with a `locale` in the body or a `bundle_member` value (pinned) | — |

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing `bind-database-loader-row-packages.test.ts` (`a bundled type's slot is per member (#32489)`), the bundled types derived from `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` × `isBundledStoreType`, the member field and canonical value from `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`:

- an unbound member binds beside another member's column-bound row, once by its body's `locale` and once by its `bundle_member` column alone;
- a member whose own slot is taken is still left `slot-taken`: canonical spelled by value beside canonical by omission, a bound `fr-FR`, and a second `de-DE` beside one bound earlier in the same run;
- a type that declares no member keeps one row per slot whatever its body or column carries;
- a derivation guard (at least one bundled type and one unbundled).

- Shared files with seat 1's landing chain: `git diff --name-only origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-<b>` for `3giljf` (landed), `wqgmuu`, `du44hj`, `phk4r9`: none of the three files of this PR is in any of them.
